fields.name: count
fields.short: Number of times this tag is used across the vault.

fields.name: content
fields.short: String payload: a heading/block body or label, a new block id for a block `marker` rename (letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores only), or a new frontmatter key name for a frontmatter `marker` rename.

fields.name: createTargetIfMissing
fields.short: Create the target (heading path, block id, or frontmatter key) if it does not already exist.

fields.name: destination
fields.short: For a heading move (operation `replace`, scope `parent`): where the section is re-parented.

fields.name: ifMatch
fields.short: Optimistic-concurrency token (the `version` from a prior document map).

fields.name: operation
fields.short: What happens to the scoped span: replace it, insert before (`prepend`) or after (`append`), or `delete` it.

fields.name: rejectIfContentPreexists
fields.short: Fail a `prepend`/`append` when the string content already appears in the target span (makes those operations idempotent on retry).

fields.name: scope
fields.short: Which part of the target the operation acts on (default `content`).

fields.name: targetType
fields.short: The kind of node to edit.

fields.name: value
fields.short: Structured JSON payload: a frontmatter value (any JSON — string, number, boolean, array, object, null; for `prepend`/`append` this merges: list concat, dict merge, string concat), or table rows on a `block` target's `content` cell (a 2-D a…

fields.name: within
fields.short: Refines a heading target to one of the section's direct-body top-level blocks (a paragraph, list, table, code fence, blockquote, …): 0 is the first block in document order, and a negative index counts from the end (-1 = last).

info.description:
The Local REST API plugin for Obsidian, which serves the open vault over HTTP on
the machine Obsidian is running on. Scoped here to the vault itself: list the
vault, read, create, replace, append to and delete a file, and list the tags in
use.

Upstream specification by the plugin authors, reduced by Voxgig. Not an official
Obsidian document, and not an API Obsidian ships: the plugin must be installed
and its API key configured.

servers.description: The Local REST API plugin, enabled inside Obsidian. HTTPS runs on 27124 with a self-signed certificate.
